verdict.rationale: LocalAI is a self-hosted runtime that serves its API from the user's own machine (localhost, a Docker container, or self-registered worker nodes). So data residency is effectively whatever location the user deploys it to, which is a property of the product's own local-first design. The evidence never explicitly addresses where data is stored, offers no residency or region controls, and does not describe where chats, models or agent data are persisted. missing for 10: explicit documentation of data storage location or persistence paths, documented residency guarantees (no external calls by default), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
